channel.title: Perch
channel.description: Updates for Perch, a tiny floating todo list for the Mac.

item.title: Version 0.1.7
item.description:
• New: Settings > General can open Perch when you log in and can hide its Dock icon.
  • Settings opens beside the panel and remembers where you move it. Its tabs have more room.
  • The Dock keeps the icon you picked, also after the Dock restarts and while Perch is quit.
  • A todo that syncs in from another device no longer goes into the undo of the todo you are typing.
